title.narrative: Transforming productivity in Palau's food systems through nature positive innovations

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

The Project aims to provide several social and economic benefits. Socially, the project will enhance food security and nutrition by promoting local food production and reducing reliance on imports. This shift is expected to improve public health, as locally produced foods are often fresher and more nutritious. Additionally, the project plans to launch awareness campaigns and educational programs to foster a long-term shift towards healthier, locally-sourced food preferences among the population, including school children and community groups??. Then, local communities, including smallholders, will benefit from capacity building programs covering areas like sustainable and nature-positive food systems, agriculture, aquaculture, and fishing practices. Economically, the project will create new opportunities by modernizing agriculture, aquaculture, and fisheries sectors, also through the development of Public-Private Partnerships (PPPs). These partnerships will leverage private sector innovation and efficiency alongside governmental support to spur investment and growth in these critical food systems. This is expected to increase productivity, create jobs, and stimulate economic growth. The project also aims to develop tailored financial mechanisms to facilitate investment in sustainable practices, thereby ensuring the long-term profitability and sustainability of these sectors?.

To promote nature-positive development, reduce ecosystem degradation, and integrate nature-based solutions into agriculture, fisheries, and aquaculture to facilitate transformation of Palau's food systems
